en: I'm feeling good about this, yes?
The anticipation... oh, it's exciting, yes?
Look at us. A couple of miscreants, ready to take on the world!
It may be the single malt but, I'm feeling very optimistic.
In life, I find that a positive outlook - and a freeze ray - makes all the difference in the world.
This is dangerous work. Fortunately, I'm dangerously handsome.
I love making new friends and even newer enemies!
United, no one can break us!
Ah, well, good luck to you and your future endeavours!
A pity we won't be working together.
If you change your mind, you know where to find me.
My... condition... will have to wait. I have other matters to attend to.
I need to see the families of my crewmates.
Answers will have to wait. I have a year of lost time to make up for.
Look at you, throwing caution to the wind!
Most people would think it's suicide to go into a battle without me, but you are an individual with no fear of looming failure, and I respect it.
Looks like I have time to finally work on that jigsaw puzzle that's been haunting me for months!
I've had my fill of the supernatural for now.
If we work together, victory is assured.
You're... the most confident dead man I've ever met.
My friend, the grave has no time for pessimism.
You, uh... hot in that thing?
You're worried at the last minute that the Patrons are gonna screw us?
Detective, now more than ever we need hope, not skepticism.
Trust me, my friend. Sometimes, it's the only thing that does.
You're one of humanity's bravest, are you not?
This isn't about me, it's about my home.
I'm not completing the ritual for my father!
He thought it was safer for me.
The reward is worth the risk!
Ah, just worried about Miss Shelly, is all.
I understand. Just know that I'll do whatever I can to help you both.
I'm still a little confused on your condition. Are you alive or dead?
I wish I knew. Little of both, I suppose.
Well, that doesn't make any sense.
It makes as much sense as me talking to an animated scrap pile, yes?
Not really. I was summoned into existence by an act of craftsmanship, willpower and sacrifice. There's a clear path that someone could replicate. You're a pseudo-corpse with a glowing rock!

Well, Miss Shelly loved reading about your adventures. When you disappeared, it was sad thinking about her not being able to read a new one before she died... but now that you're back, let's hope for one more story.
There'll be more than one, my friend.
Just wondering if getting the answers I seek is worth helping you in the process.
Now that is the question, ain't it?
You're looking a little upset, Kelvin.
I don't want to work with someone like you.
Careful, now. You keep talking like that and you might hurt my feelings. And no one wants that.
I understand that violence is going to happen in the ritual, but... it's not necessary for you to make them suffer.
I know it's not necessary, I just like to go above and beyond expectations.
Haven't seen you since the Black Château!
Well, you've been a little busy being dead.
Ah, it certainly does cut down on socializing.
Good to see you again, Kelvin.
This story writes itself: Two men of science fighting to get our lives back.
Today will be a day to remember, my friend.
You picked out a gift yet?
Well, I'm hoping my body. But if not, I've got an eye on some books.
You won't have to settle, Professor. We'll win this day.
You don't know me. You don't know my family, and I'm willing to bet you don't know what real loss feels like. So kindly keep your dime store platitudes to yourself.
Trap them in your ice dome and leave the rest to me.
Today, you create a killing floor for me. Do you understand?
I built its name. And the reputation of monster hunters is the least of my concern.
What you see in people's dreams has to be fascinating.
Nightmares are easy. There's enough commonality in what people are afraid of. What's scary is what people dream for.
The OSIC have questions about your condition.
Is this a friendly request for a chat, or a threat?
It's the federal government. Why not both?
I take it I should make myself... "unavailable" after the ritual?
What you do with your time while I'm filing reports is entirely up to you.
Stay close to me, Haze, I'll be able to heal you in my ice dome.
Today, your dome isn't for healing. It's to trap enemies inside with me.
You look more out of place than I do.
The dead rarely are consumed by fashion.
My friend, I wish I knew. I'm just looking for answers.
If all goes well, it ends today.
Good to see that Jezebel's is still up and running.
Depending on how tonight goes, it may not be runnin' much longer.
Have faith, Infernus. We won't fail.
Kelvin, I wanna make this quick so I can get back to the bar.
I look forward to celebrating with you there.
I'm sorry about what's going on in Ixia.
You don't care about what's happening back home?
I was born in New York. "Home" is right here.
You know, I could use someone like you on one of my expeditions.
Thanks for the offer, sir, but I don't think I could be away from the Arroyos that long.
If you change your mind, let me know.
I know this is an awkward time to ask, but, when this is over, would you be willing to talk to my little brother? He's a big fan of your adventure stories.
I always get a little nervous before I get shot at...
I'm already dead, so the stakes are a little lower.
I never got to say thank you for you patronage, Lady Geist.
I'm serious! Obviously, the expedition didn't go as planned, but we wouldn't have had the opportunity were it not for your funding.
I don't know. But I intend to find out.
You seem to be short on friends, Lady Geist.
I don't need friends. That's what money is for.
That way of thinking is a fast path to a lonely life. You'll realize that when you're older.
Kelvin... believe me when I tell you that you have no idea what you're talking about.
Whatever happened to your friend that cause a scene at your fundraiser? His name was... Edward? Edgar, something like that?
I don't know. I tried to find him when I returned to New York, but... it's like he's vanished.
Well, he was rather rude. So I say "good riddance".
I wish I could share that sentiment.
Well, aren't we a pair of handsome bastards?
That keep you from changing your clothes?
This glowing rock could be the only thing keeping me alive, so I'm not risking taking it off.
You should be kinder to people, Lash.
The Lash rejects the premise of your argument.
I'm not making an argument, I'm asking you to be nicer.

Kelvin... Were you there when I broke someone's left arm because they were right-handed? Or when I pointed out that a woman's baby looked stupid wearing a headband bow? The Lash needs to be nicer?! No. The Lash is a humanitarian through-and-through!
I've watched your career from afar, Miss McGinnis. Very impressive.
Thanks! You can drop the "Miss", though. Feel free to call me McGinnis or Maggie... really, anything that makes me feel like I'm not in a boardroom.
I'm looking forward to working with you, Kevin.
I think I know what I said.
Hope your back's strong, because we are gonna be carrying this team.
Uh, let's not get ahead of ourselves.
C'mon, it's just you and me. We're the two people that are gonna be keepin' everyone alive, right?
Then let's have some healthy arrogance!
The Djinn have an uphill battle facing them.
Do you think Nashala has a chance at brokering a deal?
If there's anyone that can pull it off, it will be her.
I imagine your career choice has taken you to some fantastic locales.
I look forward to reading all about them.
You won't be. Revealing those details would be a major break of Nashala's trust.
Thank you, Kelvin. May success greet us both, with open arms.
Your adventures were inspiring to read about, Kelvin.
It's nice to meet someone who actually read them.
They were riveting! I'm a, hrm, bit of an author myself, actually.
If you would be willing to take a... look at my manuscript-
I believe the ritual is about to start, but we'll catch up afterwards.
Your friendship is inspiring to behold.
Respect and certain death have a way of binding people together, don't they?
I actually moved quite a few pieces from your Ixian expedition.
Wait. The ones that were stolen?
Certainly not the ones that are still in the Met... yet.
I don't suppose you have any trinkets you'd be willing to donate to the Paradox Museum?
Why do I have the feeling that you already robbed me?
Goes to say, we definitely planned on robbing you during the ritual, but my colleague may or may not have broken into your home yet.
I'm... not sure what to say to that.
Be flattered that you lived a life interesting enough to be robbed by us.
You have so many gifts and yet you waste them on petty theft and childish stunts.
The heart wants what the heart wants, Kevin.
You... know you're held in high regard by Paradox, right?
Why? I'm an explorer, not a thief.
An explorer is just a thief that specializes in stealing from the dead.
Keep your rotting corpse away from me, ya crumbum.
So how long have you been king?
Other cultures fascinate me. I'd love to learn everything about yours.
Yeah? I bet you would… then you can pretend to be my friend and exploit us later. No thanks.
Oh, I'm just trying to figure out if I should like you because you're a dead human, of if I should hate you because you're a human that's refusing to die.
You could like me because I'm a person invested in our survival…
Then I let you stew on when I'll come to kill you.
Don't worry Kelvin, I won't let you die.
Heh, I thought you hated me.
I do. But if anyone is going to kill you, it's going to be me.
No barbed words before the ritual?
Kelvin, whatever it is you are now is a pale imitation of the man you were. To mock someone in your state of frailty is beneath me.
Kelvin, you're dead. The last thing I wanna do is end up like you.
Is that... wereotter fur on the parka?
Oh, come on, you have Geist Foundation money!
Look at us: A couple of walking corpses ready to stare death in the eye.
You seem fairly cheerful about it.
Why not? It's better than the alternative.
You have no issues with being a grotesque mirror of humanity?
My friend... we were gifted unnatural life. Don't squander it. Travel. Write a book! Find love.
I'm not taking advice from someone wearing a parka in New York.
You have a plan for the battle, my morose friend?
My plans tend to devolve into me throwing my body at my enemies until we all drown in blood.
Ideally, I rise like a macabre phoenix, but... it doesn't always work out.
I'll do whatever I can to keep you in the fight, Victor.
Eh, some people say revenant, but... I'm not sure if there's really a difference.
I understand. I just stick with "ghost" for simplicity's sake.
That ice dome of yours had best not block my line of sight.
Vindicta... my priority will always be saving life, not facilitating you ending it.
That's your problem, Kelvin. I am saving life.
It's strange returning after being gone for a year.
Oh, by no means was I trying to draw comparisons. How long did it take you to make sense of the modern world?
A while. People always ask me about adapting to technology but, really, the language was the hardest. For a while, I felt lost. But I was able to find my way, and my purpose.
A lust for murder isn't purpose, Vindicta.
That's not for you to say, Kelvin. You weren't there.
Hey, you're that, uh, judgy corpse, right?
I don't think I'm particularly judgmental.
What do you think about me?
That you've spent more time inside prison than outside of it, so perhaps crime is not what you're best suited for.
You got any "liquid courage" in that parka of yours? You know, for when it gets cold!
Neat, anyway, back to the whiskey question.
Hey, uh, Kelvin, can you spat me some dough?
Cause I want 10 bucks and I feel like you probably have it?
I am not giving you any money.
We don't have time for cynicism today, Wraith.
I've seen the contempt you have for your fellow man.
You say contempt, I say... "managed expectations".
Correct. It's time I find answers.
People say you're a noble man.
Noble men tend to get other people killed.
I will endeavor to make sure that's not the case.
Oh, yes. I suppose I am. Be grateful that I kill on your behalf today.
If it doesn't kill 'em, it'll slow them down.
I need to deal with groups.
When the waves come, I'll be ready.
These should keep them at bay.
It's like a snowball... If snowballs could explode and kill your neighbours.
What's the point of being a scientist if you don't get to blow things up?!
I've learned many things in my travels.
(Alt:I'm not dead yet... well, technically I'm suppose I'm a wight, but let's not get bogged down by specifics.)
I must be ready to give chase!
It pays to have an exit strategy.
I bring Rockefeller Plaza wherever I go.
I can go anywhere in this city.
Who knows where the magic ends, and the science begins!
A chill wind is about to blow.
Oh, they really hate it when I use this!
Now, aside from my devastating good looks, this is what else I'm known for.
This is why I am feared.
Being an Ice Wight has its advantages.
Soon, they will run from me!
This is why I was chosen!
They will die a frozen death.
Only I can bear the Arctic chill safely.
Ready to build an ice dome!
We'll be safe in my ice dome!
Ready to build the Frozen Shelter!
Nothing will get through my ice dome!
When the time comes, I'll build a shelter.
Ready to trap them in my ice dome!
I will isolate them from their friends!
I'll fight them on my terms!
I have a few tricks up my sleeve!
It's about to get cold out there!
Let's see how you fare now!
And where, pray tell, do you think you're going?
I won't meet my final debt!
Thought you had me, didn't you?
All I need is a little more time!
Damn it! I froze the objective.
No one's getting the Rejuvenator but us!
Don't feel bad, my friend, no one is better than me.
If you're going to lose, at least you lost to the best, yes?
They throw their lives away with such gusto!
It appears they have confused courage with stupidity!
You asked for this fight, my friend.
I had no choice but to defend myself!
It's in your best interest to stay down.
They may have the money, but we have the talent.
All good things come to an end.
If someone's going to kill me, it's going to be Ettrick, not you.
I knew we could work together!
We keep this up, and it will be over in no time!
We make a good team, yes?
It would appear that I'm on a roll, yes?
It's not your fault that you're not better than me. It's just is what it is!
If only Ettrick could see me now.
Will none of you rise to the challenge?!
I came to fight the best, and so far... Eh, I'm sorely disappointed.
Ugh. I almost feel bad for them.
There's no shame in surrender, friends.
Let me deal with their magic!
Ready to heal from their pain!
So this is what being Lady Geist feels like.
I gotta get to the store.
Hm, might want to get some gear.
I can buy some better gear now.
Maybe now's the time to go shopping.
I can afford some quality merchandise.
Ah, I can get some high tier equipment!
There's nothing I can't get at the shop!
I wonder what they have at the Curiosity Shop?
This is the moment I've been saving for!
I'll put these souls to good use.
Can't leave souls lying around now, can we?!
Hm, if no one's going to claim it... I might as well!
Who am I to say no to free souls!
Ha, no sense letting this go to waste!
No worries, friends. We got the objective.
We're closer to summoning the Patron!
Come out and face me with courage!
Only a rat feels the need to hide!
It's getting a little rough out there.
They'll have to try harder than that if they want to kill me.
Today is not the day I die.
Urgh, I need to be careful.
I need to stay sharp, I don't have any backup!
And once again... I am all alone.
Don't worry, friends. I'll do my best to slow them down.
I won't let the team down.
Urgh, I don't like how the numbers are looking.
There's nothing to be gained by charging into a fight where I'm outnumbered!
Now that we have the Rejuvenator, what's our plan?
They picked up the Rejuv, we can't afford to make mistakes!
I must help my new friends!
No one can win this battle on their own!
You're on your own for now!
I'll be back when I can.
Urgh, this battle is taking it's toll!
So, friends, who among you is ready to summon an Elder God?
This will be an expedition to remember!
I have been given a second chance at life, and I won't squander it.
I'm so close to finding the answers I seek!
We don't have to like each other, but we need to work together as a team.
Once the Ritual begins, there's no time for fear or second guesses.
We fought with courage, and now we reap the rewards!
The answers to my condition will no longer elude me.
They fought well, but it wasn't enough.
The guardians will deal with them.
I knew I could count on you, old friend.
I wish I had you on the expedition!
You know how to use a bow, sir!
Thanks for the help, Grey Talon!
Talon was looking out for us.
So that's what the OSIC does.
Remind me never to get on her hit list!
Turns out the government actually is here to help! Hm!
I love working with you, Infernus.
He made short work of that!
Damn it, they took out Ivy!
Ivy, I knew I could depend on you.
They were fools for getting close to her!
They're cursing Lady Geist's name for sure!
You know how to make an enterance, Lash!
Give the mole man a hand!
He's as dangerous as they said... But at least he's on our side.
That's... probably why the Baxter Society never kicked him out.
Even his hair still looks perfect!
The man's a force of nature!
They don't have a chance against Shiv!
This is like being frozen in ice without the trauma...
Bebop, I really wish you'd stop trying to kill me.
I am not afraid of you, Bebop.
You have to try harder than that, Bebop!
How can so much anger fill up such a tiny man?
Billy. You need to relax and enjoy life!
Billy. Hating life won't get you very far.
That cat deserves better than you, Calico.
I put an end to your tricks, Doorman.
No more reality-bending for you, my friend!
You won't prey on us, Drifter.
No more innocents will suffer at your hands!
A pity I couldn't stop him sooner.
I'm sorry, my friend, but I can't let you win.
I wish I didn't have to do that, professor.
If I never see a black hole again, it will be too soon.
I'm sorry, Grey Talon. I don't have a choice.
There are other ways to seek justice, Talon.
I'm sorry for your loss, Talon, but... this isn't going to solve anything.
Glad I took her out before she killed us all.
If it makes you feel better, I got lucky.
You were never getting away, Haze!
Your intentions are noble, sheriff, but I can't let you win.
You came a long way to fail, sheriff.
We're all looking for answers, Holliday. Sadly, you won't be getting yours today.
That lasso was never going to get it done.
Ugh, such a good bartender, too!
See you at the bar later?
And here I thought your fire-starting days were behind you, Infernus.
Infernus, back to your old tricks, I see.
Infernus. You didn't think that would work, did you?
I wish I was fighting alongside you, not against you.
Ivy won't be helping her team for a while.
You're the monster, Geist, not Oathkeeper.
I won't be fed to your pet spirit, Geist.
That woman needs to be stopped!
I won't let that monster get what she wants!
Geist is looking to steal your health!
Eh, I don't see what the big deal is.
That solves our little Lash problem.
Everyone needs to be humbled, Lash.
McGinnis, you deserve more than being a lackey for Maximilian.
You're no better than Calico, McGinnis.
I could never trade my morals for coin like that woman.
You made your choice when you signed with Fairfax Industries.
Your machines aren't getting it done, McGinnis!
I'll deal with McGinnis' little toys!
How many of these things does she have?!
You have much to learn, Mina.
Maybe you're not as invincible as you think you are, Mina.
She is precarious, to put it mildly.
I empathize with the Djinn, but their fight isn't my own!
You're a man of principles, Mirage, I respect that.
There's no shame in losing to me, Mirage.
You two are fun guys, Ha!.. Sorry about shooting you.
Nothing personal, Mo, it's just business.
They're a scrappy pair, aren't they?
That young lady has a bright future ahead of her, but... Today, she will be a failure.
I hate to stifle such imagination.
Today we are enemies, but hopefully tomorrow... We should be allies.
Paradox is no longer a threat.
We need not worry about Paradox.
You're clever, Paradox, but you're not better than me.
You're not as smart as you think, Paradox.
I've been put in worse death traps.
You have to be faster if you want to catch me, Paradox!
This is not your day, Pocket.
This can't be the life you want for yourself, Pocket.
Seven could only elude consequence for so long.
You're just a bully, Shiv. And I hate bullies...
Oh you want to pick on someone, Shiv? Pick on me!
You give the Baxter Society a bad name, Shiv.
It'll take more than knives to stop me.
Take your knife throwing act somewhere else!
I never thought I'd be at war with the Vatican!
Come, Venator, and learn that I'm not easy prey!
You'll have to try harder, Venator!
You don't have what it takes to stop me, Venator!
I was hoping us corpses could stick together.
I wish you good luck on your search, my friend, but... I can't let you win.
Sadly, my search for the truth has to trump your own.
If you wanted to be "glass half-full"... At least he's not in pain.
Your cause is just, Vindicta, but your methods...
I suppose now is probably a bad time to give a lecture on violence.
Go back to the Deep, Viscous. It's safer.
The surface is no place for a sea anemone.
That goo suit was only going to last for so long.
Vyper's an odd one, that's for sure.
She certainly has a... unique personality.
Alas, Vyper, I have not acquired a taste for your charm.
She won't be harassing us for a bit.
You're not the law, Warden. You're just a glorified bounty hunter.
Your goals are noble, Warden. Your tactics, eh, less so.
I won't back down from you, Warden.
I'll stand up to you, Warden, no matter the costs!
Don't have to worry about Wraith any more.
I may not bleed, but... that doesn't mean I'm looking to get stabbed.
The Seventh Moon's time ends tonight!
A sword was never going to be enough.
Be back as soon as I can!
Thanks for keeping me in the fight!
I'll be back when I can, Kelvin.
Cutting it a little close, aren't we, Kelvin?
Your aid will not be forgotten.
Kelvin's keeping me in the fight.
I thought I was really in trouble for a minute.
Hey, Kevin... Kelvin! Your name's Kelvin!
Thanks for taking care of me, Kelvin.
Don't fail me this time, Kelvin.
Cutting it a little close, aren't we?
Thanks for having my back, Kelvin.
Kelvin will be able to hold his own.
Now there goes a man with gusto!
I knew I could count on you, Kelvin.
Thanks for keeping us in the fight.
Kelvin can hold his own for a while.
Kelvin's dead! That saved me some time later.
They killed Kelvin! Someone's getting a fruit basket later!
What game are you playing at, Kelvin?
Don't think this buys my loyalty.
Thanks for keeping me standing, Kelvin.
Now I get to not die!
You kept me in the fight, Kelvin.
I knew I could count on you, Kelvin.
Who wears a parka this time o' year?
You seem like a decent guy, Kelvin. But you had to be stopped.
What are you gonna do, ice skate me to death?
You were never getting away, Kelvin.
I've read stories about you, Kelvin... you fell a little short of the legend.
Not all adventures have a happy ending, Kelvin.
No one cheats death forever, Kelvin!
I put Kelvin in the ground.
And where did you think you were going, Kelvin?
At least you made me work for it, Kelvin.
Your freeze ray was never gonna get the job done, mate!
Nothin' personal, Kelvin. You had to go.
Why don't you take your dumb parka, and piss off back to the Arctic?
New York's not cold enough for you? What an asshole.
That guy likes to pretend he's on some moral high ground, but he was happy to take Geist's money.
You sucked in the Arctic, you suck in the city, what're you good at?!
You tried to cheat and not walk on the ground like a normal person, but that ain't happenin' on my watch!
You're a clever man, Kelvin. Why did you think you could beat me?
Your expedition has come to an end, Kelvin.
The bravest men are often the most stupid.
You were never going to escape me, Kelvin.
I could smell that parka a mile away.
The undead give me the creeps.
I took care of the ice wight.
Your ice path is adorable, but it's not bending space and time.
Kelvin, you didn't think we were going to get away, did you?

You wrestle with so much guilt. The things you know you did and, even more horrifying, the things you forgot. But at The Baroness, you don’t need to worry about Ettrick or the expedition. Let me lighten the load.
You pushed away Ettrick for his ambitions, yet remained a slave to your own.
All he could do was delay the inevitable.
Kelvin, all you managed to do was prolong your suffering.
Kelvin, you are a man after my own heart, and I am so sorry I had to do that.
It's an awkward time to say this, Kelvin, but I love your book.
Even when he's fighting you, that guy is just so classy.
Best of luck next time, Kelvin.
I read a lot about him. He seemed cool.
I wish I wasn't fighting him, I have a million questions...
I bet my mentor would love to get her hands on that stone.
I might be able to help you, Kelvin... not today, obviously, because I killed you, but in the future!
The dead belong in the ground.
Kelvin, I'll give you the peace you seek.
Quit while you still can, Kelvin.
There is no mercy for you today, Kelvin!
At least you made me work for it, Kelvin.
Respect to you, Kelvin. You put up a fight.
You're well trained, but not trained enough.
It's adorable that you thought that dome of yours would stop me.
There's no running from me, Kelvin.
I tried to reason with you, Kelvin.
And I thought I was out of place in New York.
Kelvin. You're not ready to fight someone like me.
You're not getting away that easy, Kelvin.
You think you can skate away from me?
New York ain't the place for you, Kelvin.
Your little expedition has come to an end.
You were never gettin' away, Kelvin.
That ice path was never gonna get it done.
You gotta be a lot faster than that, Kelvin.
Consider this the official removal of my funding.
How dare you oppose me, Kelvin!
Fighting for them?! After everything I have done for you?!
You can't run from me, Kelvin.
Had a good plan, Kelvin. Shame you couldn't execute it.
I'm not getting trapped by you, Kelvin.
Took out Kevin – Kelvin. His name is Kelvin. I'm gonna get that right next time...
I took out that... guy whose name I always get wrong.
Snow cone won't be bothering us for a bit.
I thought that guy was supposed to be a big deal.
You make walking corpses look bad, Kelvin.
You know, Kelvin, maybe if you stopped underestimating people, your whole expedition wouldn't have died in the Arctic.
Well, that was a sad getaway.
Kelvin won't be supporting his team for a while.
It was a good fight, Kelvin.
And that's why you go underground when you're trying to escape!
I know they say you "don't meet your heroes" and he tried to kill me, but... I don't care! Kelvin. Is. Great!
He was as impressive as the stories said!
Ahh! I get to be the antagonist in one of Kelvin's stories!
This will make the next book signing a little awkward!
We could've worked well together, Kelvin.
Knocked Kelvin off his high horse.
I think I found a new favorite person to mess with!
You made the wrong enemy, Kelvin.
I idolized him when I was younger.
The dead need to stay buried.
It was always going to come down to you and me, Kelvin.
You can't run from me, Kelvin!
You got what you deserved, Kelvin!
Kelvin! You can't run from me forever!
Oh Kelvin, so noble, so predictable.
Guess the rumors about Kelvin being a tough guy are unfounded!
He won't be supporting his team for a while.
Won't have to deal with that ice wight for a while.
